checklist: Open the 360 px right History drawer in Light mode
Check readable filename, time, source, summary, Current, Ready, and marked labels
Check Preview and Restore remain visible without clipping
Open More Actions in Light mode
Check 180 × 84 px menu, 32 px trigger, Mark/Unmark, Delete, separator, and clipping
Enter read-only version Preview in Light mode
Check preview is distinguishable from current drawing and Exit/Restore remain reachable
Open Restore confirmation in Light mode
Check Cancel has visible initial focus and dialog text/actions are not clipped
humanLiveObservations: After closing the modal, visually check focus returns to its triggering control; record a separate reviewer verdict

checklist: Show external recovery in Light mode
Check issue, Preview, Save As, Keep current file, and Discard recovery remain readable
humanLiveObservations: Open Discard recovery confirmation and visually check its destructive hierarchy; record a separate reviewer verdict

checklist: Show compact 300 px History drawer in Dark mode
Check contrast, state labels, row/action readability, and horizontal clipping
Show the generic History error state
Check error title, safe retry guidance, current drawing identity, and unclipped actions
Show the History conflict state
Check conflict title, recovery guidance, current drawing identity, and unclipped safe actions
Show the pending or processing state
Check status is readable and visually distinct from success; no action is clipped
Show a resource-unavailable History item
Check reason, safe exit or retry guidance, current drawing identity, and unclipped actions
Show a focused History row with its visible focus indicator in the capture
humanLiveObservations: Visually inspect focus indicators on More Actions, Preview, modal Cancel, and Close in separate live moments
After Escape or close, visually inspect focus returned to the triggering control
Record a separate reviewer verdict; T023 owns keyboard behavior

checklist: Enable macOS Reduce Motion before opening History
Check state and focus remain understandable with no transition hiding either
